# `Optional[Decimal]` with field constraints error: Unable to apply constraint 'max_digits' to schema of type 'function-after'

### Description

In Pydantic version `2.9`, the `Decimal | None` raise the following error:  `Unable to apply constraint 'max_digits' to schema of type 'function-after'` when applied basic field constraints like `max_digits`, `decimal_places` etc. This was not the behavior in the previous `2.8`. Some of our microservices use the 2.8 and the new ones use 2.9 and the new ones are facing this issue.  The following is the code that causes the issue:

```py
  height_in_cm: Decimal | None = Field(
      default=None,
      gt=0,
      max_digits=10,
      decimal_places=4,
      allow_inf_nan=False,
      title="Height in cm",
      description="The height of the client in cm.",
  )
  weight_in_kg: Decimal | None = Field(
      default=None,
      gt=0,
      max_digits=10,
      decimal_places=4,
      allow_inf_nan=False,
      title="Weight in kg",
      description="The weight of the client in kg.",
  )
  ```
  
  I tried everything possible from removing some contraints, playing around with `Annotated` as well. I even modified the code to use Annotated as mentioned by others:
  
  ```py
  height_in_cm: (
      Annotated[
          Decimal,
          Field(
              gt=0,
              max_digits=10,
              decimal_places=4,
              allow_inf_nan=False,
              title="Height in cm",
              description="The height of the client in cm.",
          ),
      ]
      | None
  ) = Field(
      default=None,
      title="Height in cm",
      description="The height of the client in cm.",
  )
  weight_in_kg: (
      Annotated[
          Decimal,
          Field(
              gt=0,
              max_digits=10,
              decimal_places=4,
              allow_inf_nan=False,
              title="Weight in kg",
              description="The weight of the client in kg.",
          ),
      ]
      | None
  ) = Field(
      default=None,
      title="Weight in kg",
      description="The weight of the client in kg.",
  )
  ````
  
  Still, nothing works. I am still getting the `RuntimeError: Unable to apply constraint 'max_digits' to schema of type 'function-after'`.
